🧐❗️Watch out for the 'Spallettate': #Cambiaso can operate on both flanks, but #Spalletti is also evaluating him in midfield as an alternative to #DouglasLuiz. #Çelik is expected to return to the right, keeping the possibility open to play as one of the three central defenders as well. Nico #González is even more important: he can play as a wide midfielder, a winger, an attacking midfielder or a false nine.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🔛🆙 #Juventus wants to intervene in January especially in midfield, where a regista capable of dictating the tempo is lacking. The main target is #Hojbjerg: the idea would be to finance him through the exit of #Koopmeiners. Another priority is the left-back: #AitNouri is evaluated as a loan option, while #EmersonPalmieri remains in the running.[Niccolò Ceccarini - TMW via @juventusinsidernews]

PLAYERS I HAVE IMPACTED POSITIVELY - "I'll mention a few, the most vivid in my mind: #Pizarro at Udine, #Lobotka and #Kvara at #Napoli, #Salah at #Roma and #Cancelo at #Inter. #Kvara came from a unique style of football, but #Salah delivers a Ballon d'Or to anyone who coaches him, let it be clear. As an attacking midfielder, I am convinced #Pizarro would have had less prominence compared to acting in front of the defense: there, you touch 300% more balls. In crowded and tight places, you have to tear open the gaps, just like in the penalty box today. You have to take it away from someone else. That way, #David showcased his talent more. At #Juventus, on the other hand, you coach a mentality: it is the history of football. Here there is the #Juventus way: it is not just an impetuous emotion. 💎❗️#Juventus has been completely captivated by #Inacio and is monitoring him closely. He is considered a favorite target for the bianconeri as part of the club's corporate project aimed at strengthening the Italian component of the squad. However, it will not be easy: several top European clubs are tracking him, including #Inter. The bianconeri remain vigilant and ready to seize any potential opportunities.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇮🇹👀 In addition to #Leoni, #Juventus is following several Italian profiles: radars are on for #Ndour and #Kayode, who is unlikely to remain at #Brentford for long and the bianconeri are lined up. In January, the club would like to book #Palmisani, which does not rule out #Vicario: they could find themselves together in Turin. The management has also set their eyes on #Marcandalli and #Lipani.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇮🇹🧐 #Juventus continues to monitor #Leoni: they had already requested information for a loan, but #Liverpool rejected. Despite the 'no', the bianconeri continue to send scouts to closely follow his progress. The objective is to remain at the front of the queue and evaluate a new attempt in the coming months.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
